claim_boundary: Each result verifies that one exact public statement appeared in the fetched UN-Habitat World Cities Report 2026: The Global Housing Crisis — Pathways to Action bytes on 2026-09-07. It does not independently establish the statement's underlying real-world truth.
review_design: retrospective deterministic source-publication audit; not preregistered, not an independent fact-check, and not an independent reproduction
source_name: UN-Habitat World Cities Report 2026: The Global Housing Crisis — Pathways to Action
selection_method: Deterministic sentence extraction with minimum length and prose-quality filters, signal scoring, duplicate removal, and per-page concentration limits.
verification_rule: Extract PDF text with the selecting extractor and an independent extractor, compare each quote after removing layout whitespace and hyphens, require every quote once or more in both extractions, and require the complete fetched PDF SHA-256 to match.

records.public_claim_text: Affordability constraints, rising displacement, pervasive informality, increasing climate-related risks, and declining neighbourhood liveability collectively define the contemporary housing landscape.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Affordability constraints, rising displacement, pervasive informality, increasing climate-related risks, and declining neighbourhood liveability collectively define the contemporary housing landscape.

records.public_claim_text: Supporting community-driven and incremental housing models as legitimate and scalable pathways to adequacy is also critical, particularly in contexts where informal construction constitutes a major share of housing provision.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Supporting community-driven and incremental housing models as legitimate and scalable pathways to adequacy is also critical, particularly in contexts where informal construction constitutes a major share of housing provision.

records.public_claim_text: Effective housing policies should go beyond an ownership centric, property-oriented approach to housing development to embrace the diversity in tenure types – from informal settlements and rental housing to collective and community arrangements – while prioritizing in situ upgrading and the enhancement of existing stock through adaptive reuse and stronger rental frameworks.

records.public_claim_text: Though the data on evictions is partial and incomplete, analysis by UN-Habitat for this report estimates that at least 64 million people were displaced from informal settlement by urban development processes between 2003 and 2023.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: Though the data on evictions is partial and incomplete, analysis by UN-Habitat for this report estimates that at least 64 million people were displaced from informal settlement by urban development processes between 2003 and 2023.

records.public_claim_text: Refugees, IDPs, evictees and other groups of the urban displaced fall under very different protection regimes, leaving many with little no support.

records.public_claim_text: Channeling humanitarian funding through local governments can strengthen long-term service capacity for all urban residents.
